changeSummary: Disclose the Agent Control Send action for Feedback and pending Crash Reports, the local Feedback payload preview, and deletion of the current pending report after choosing Don’t Ask Again.
dateRationale: November 22, 2026 is the planned 0.26.3 release date. This revision describes new local command access to existing submission paths.
scope: Review of Feedback, Crash Reports and update behavior from v0.26.2 (abc83e75) through d15719a6 plus the 0.26.3 release documentation.

evidence.source: PLVS: src/uiNavigation/UiNavigationContext.jsx, src/agentControl/handlers/ui.js, src/hooks/useFeedbackDraft.js, src/lib/feedback.js and docs/agent-control/ui.md
evidence.notes: Agent Control is opt-in. An explicit Send against the current mounted dialog invokes its existing submit action. Dry-run returns a local preview without issuing a POST. Diagnostics remain opt-in and the endpoint and payload fields are unchanged.

Crash reports use the existing explicit Send callback, request and endpoint. The current local report is removed after success or when dismissed with Don’t Send or Don’t Ask Again. The display-change event stays in the local application.

evidence.source: PLVS: src-tauri/src/update_cache.rs, src-tauri/src/update_runtime.rs, src/hooks/useUpdatePreferences.js and src/agentControl/handlers/update.js
evidence.notes: Agent Control invokes the existing manual update and settings paths. Cache changes replace older downloads and remove rejected packages locally. The preference gates, network destinations and request data are unchanged.

evidence.source: PLVS-Website: live publication.json and the pinned renderer
evidence.notes: The release uses the current live site renderer. The privacy content comes from the PLVS policy source.

limitations: Review covers the changed desktop and website sources. The release does not change the report service, mail provider or server retention, and this review did not re-audit their deployed configuration.
